change_summary: Held-book PIT risk-budget overlay (15% single-name risk cap + 30% vol target, monthly, trailing-90d cov, excess to cash) vs static hold over 3 standard windows.
hypothesis: Held-book risk-budget overlay: applying a PIT risk-contribution cap (cap any single name at 15% of ex-ante portfolio risk) plus a 30% annualized vol target (excess to cash), rebalanced monthly using ONLY trailing 90d covariance, improves risk-adjusted return (Sharpe up, max-drawdown down) at acceptable return cost versus static buy-and-hold of the same held names, aggregated over the three standard windows. Motivated by the read-only diagnostic (scripts/probe_held_book_concentration.py): MUU alone is 34% of portfolio risk and the only real de-risk lever is raising cash, not rotating among correlated high-beta names. Observed-only policy simulation on the held universe; no core-strategy/order/ranking change; discretionary risk policy if it wins.
notes: Overlay cuts worst max-drawdown 44%->15% (Δ+30pp) but halves aggregate EV (44.4->18.6) by giving up ~34pp return: the 30% vol target forces 18-33% cash in the two bull windows and caps winners (~45% upside capture). Big winner only in old_thin (the drawdown window: -12%->-1%, DD 44%->11%). Static-target de-risking is regime-indiscriminate. NOT a forbidden-retry to sweep cap/vol-target; the real next axis is regime-CONDITIONED de-risking (only in adverse/chop regimes, full in confirmed uptrends) or an objective that weights tail-risk. Survivorship: universe=currently-held winners.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not sweep the single-name risk cap, vol target, lookback, rebalance frequency, or held-book universe on the same three windows. That would be a parameter retune of the rejected regime-indiscriminate static-target overlay.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A valid retry needs a different evidence axis: a regime-conditioned overlay that de-risks only in adverse/chop regimes, a tail-risk-weighted objective where drawdown reduction is explicitly valued, genuinely uncorrelated ballast, or a forward non-survivorship book.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The 30% vol target forced substantial cash in the bull windows, capping high-beta winners. The drawdown improvement was real, especially in old_thin, but the return drag dominated expected value versus static hold.

prediction.confidence_reason: Diagnostic strongly implies vol-target-to-cash cuts vol with Sharpe ~unchanged; but trailing Sharpe is bull-window-inflated and static hold of winners is a hard baseline to beat on return.

rejection_reason: No AGENTS.md Gate 4 acceptance condition was met.
